{{Quote|I was stationed aboard the ''Silent Water'' the last time Kal-tan-shi was spotted by Alliance operatives, this time in the Veron system. I was immediately transferred there and began the hunt for him.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tole Warren]]|<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Silent Water''''' was a [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Navy/Legends|starfleet]]. The ship was commanded by [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] and acted as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of his Alliance [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. It also played a major role in the [[Battle of Heterkus]]. Other crew members included communications officer [[G'hengle]], a [[Unidentified Rebel lieutenant (Silent Water)|pilot]],<ref name="RC">''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]''</ref> and lieutenant [[Tole Warren]].<ref name="air" />
